The integration failed due to a header mismatch in the Unit_Results sheet where 'Earliest_Scheduled_Shift_Date' was provided instead of the expected 'Required_Shift_Start_Date'.
Execution failed with verifier_reward 0.00 and a call_failed status in pytest. The Node.js test harness reported AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Unit_Results R6C11 mismatch. Specifically, the actual value '+ Earliest_Scheduled_Shift_Date' did not match the expected '- Required_Shift_Start_Date' at /tests/test_outputs.js:296:12. Ensure the spreadsheet generation logic uses the exact column naming conventions required by the verifier.
